evidence_1_extra_information: See same_macro_different_local.json; actual data contain macro-near pairs with distinct plantar/IMU observations.

evidence_2_early_warning.limitation: Thresholds and false-alarm rates use the same non-fall calibration episodes, so they are preliminary. This is an offline warning study, not a failure-rate estimate or a closed-loop result.

evidence_3_directional_loading_margin.array_interval_definition: lower uses active cell centers; upper uses full extents of active integration cells; true within-cell contact support is unresolved by the present CSV.
evidence_3_directional_loading_margin.scope: single-foot contact loading margin, not whole-robot fall stability
